صَوْكٌ The seminal fluid of a man. (Th, Kr, K.) ＝
-A2- Also The first. (K.) One says, لَقِيتُهُ أَوَّلَ صَوْكٍ and بُوْكٍ I met him the first thing. (S, O, K.) And in like manner, اِفْعَلْهُ أَوَّلَ كُلِّ صَوْكٍ and بَوْكٍ [Do thou it the first of everything]. (TA.) And خُذْ هٰذَا أَوَّلَ صَوْكٍ: see 1 in art. صك. (O and TA in that art.) ＝
-A3- Also Motion: so in the phrase مَا بِهِ صَوْكٌ and بَوْكٌ [There is not in him, or it, any motion]. (IDrd, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
